metadata.title: Common Shade — India heat-resilience snapshot
metadata.method: Targeted primary-source desk review; not a systematic review or exhaustive legal/implementation audit.
metadata.facts_and_interpretations: Evidence fields record source descriptions; proposed_collaboration/could_contribute are researcher proposals. Taxonomy tags are analytical relevance, not measured interruption of loops.
metadata.taxonomy: User-supplied ids retained. Live home page shows different counters; reconcile version before import.
metadata.no_endorsement: Inclusion implies no partnership, affiliation, availability or endorsement. Organisations are not ranked.
metadata.cost_policy: No intervention cost numbers published without verified currency/year/FX and lifecycle basis. Missing values are null, not zero.
metadata.city_ranking_warning: Selected cases are not a verified national top-eight exposure ranking.

country.name: India
country.scope: Eight documented high-heat concern/action cities, not a verified ranking of India’s eight most exposed cities.

heat_context.summary: India spans hot-dry, composite and hot-humid contexts. District composite risk, daytime weather alerts, humid heat, night heat and indoor exposure are different measures.

official_plans_and_authority.description: National guidance, state/district/local HAPs and health-sector plans operate through different institutional/legal routes. Publication alone is not a separately enforceable heat entitlement.
official_plans_and_authority.current_rules_check: Central OSH Rules 2026 are notified, not a draft. Check appropriate-government, sector and state implementation.

warning_system.description: IMD meteorological guidance informs health and local response. Separate forecast, action and financial payout triggers; household receipt not verified.

cooling_and_building_policy.description: ICAP workstreams, BEE building/retrofit resources and Telangana cool-roof policy provide entry points; local notification, compliance and affordability require checks.

uncertainty.known: Primary plans, guidance and selected studies exist as documented.
uncertainty.inferred: Place-based coordination and project preparation could connect currently separate protection functions.
uncertainty.uncertain: A comparable national city exposure ranking, current ward delivery, lifecycle costs, complete heat mortality, enforcement and disbursement.

cities.name: Ahmedabad
cities.selection_basis: Documented heat-health action and observational programme research.

heat_context.description: Hot inland setting; seasonal humidity changes require local assessment.
heat_context.night_heat: Include overnight indoor and outdoor measurements in local assessment; no comparable current city-wide indoor/night exposure series verified here.
heat_context.trend_note: Use national/district and local-plan evidence at its stated scale; no comparable current municipal time-series trend estimate is reproduced here.
heat_context.climate_description_basis: Broad contextual description, not a formal climate-zone classification; seasonal conditions need local validation.

plans.verified_description: Ahmedabad HAP collaboration and retrospective research verified; current signed 2026 plan/version not retrieved.
plans.legal_status: Administrative/policy or state health planning instrument as described; plan publication is not proof every action is legally enforceable.

warning_system.last_mile_reach: Not verified; test radio, local-language announcements, worker groups and door-to-door routes as proposed design, not existing universal coverage.

occupational_heat_rules.note: Obtain current state/sector orders, jurisdiction and wage/rest terms; do not import a different state’s timetable.

cooling_and_building_policy.note: Check actual state/local notifications, building ownership and retrofit permissions before specifying compliance.

finance.note: Screen eligible project costs separately from staffing, electricity and upkeep; budget route is not a grant offer.

proposed_collaboration.interpretation: Pair ward housing/work protection with accountable warnings and mortality analysis.

evidence_gaps: Current shelter/roof coverage, tenant inclusion and recurrent costs not verified.
No common national municipality-level exposure ranking verified.

sources.title: CEEW: How Extreme Heat Is Impacting India
sources.review_note: Methods and findings reviewed. District composite risk, not a municipal exposure ranking; IMDAA historical reanalysis and socioeconomic indicators. Older financing recommendations are not current law.

sources.title: IMD heat-wave FAQ
sources.review_note: Definitions and warning guidance reviewed. Meteorological thresholds are not individual safety limits, indoor exposure measurements or insurance triggers.

sources.title: NCDC advisory for State Health Departments, summer 2026
sources.review_note: Preparedness, task forces and daily IHIP surveillance instructions reviewed. Instructions do not establish reporting completeness or service delivery.

sources.title: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions (Central) Rules 2026
sources.review_note: Final Gazette GSR 345(E), English rules reviewed selectively. Factory ventilation/temperature provisions, artificial-humidification controls and construction provisions have different scopes. Appropriate-government and establishment coverage require local legal confirmation.

sources.title: MHA policy and guidelines register
sources.review_note: Official register lists response and mitigation guidelines for 2026–27 to 2030–31. Older generic fund webpages can lag these documents.

sources.title: MHA SDRF/NDRF operational guidelines, 2026–31
sources.review_note: Web-reader rendered English PDF page 12 reviewed: paragraph 2 lists heatwave and lightning. Direct-download extraction inconsistently returned mitigation text under this response filename; confirm authoritative copy and applicable assistance norms with MHA/state before any transaction.

sources.title: MHA SDMF/NDMF operational guidelines, 2026–31
sources.review_note: Downloaded primary PDF, English text reviewed. SDMF section 7.1 explicitly includes heatwave; sections 1, 3, 5 and 7 describe mitigation scope and state planning. No specific heat allocation or release established.

sources.title: Ozone Cell: India Cooling Action Plan and implementation reports
sources.review_note: Official plan/implementation index reviewed. Space cooling, cold-chain, servicing and low-GWP research are separate workstreams. No city access entitlement inferred.

sources.title: BEE reports and studies: ENS/ECSBC 2024 and retrofit resources
sources.review_note: Current official catalogue reviewed; lists ENS 2024, ECSBC 2024, residential retrofit manuals and district-cooling guidance. Full 2024 code clauses and state notifications not audited.

sources.title: Delhi Heat Action Plan 2025
sources.review_note: Selected operational roles, phases, contents and partner acknowledgements reviewed. Published plan is not proof of delivery, budget release or legally enforceable wage protection.

sources.title: DDMA plan register
sources.review_note: Official list: 2025 HAP is latest retrieved heat-plan entry; 2024 plan and 2023 draft also listed. No inference that unpublished/newer directions do not exist.

sources.title: Tamil Nadu State Heat Action Plan 2026
sources.review_note: Primary plan downloaded from TN-SMART/RIMES portal; selected governance, heat-risk and financing sections reviewed. Embedded older relief rules need reconciliation with July 2026 MHA guidelines.

sources.title: Chennai City Heat Action Plan 2025
sources.review_note: Downloaded original plan; cover, government-order reference, methods, action tables, financing and coordination sections reviewed. CEEW/TNDRRA authorship; funding section expressly indicative and subject to eligibility/approval.

sources.title: TN-SMART heat action plan catalogue
sources.review_note: Catalogue/HTML links reviewed. TNDRRA_Chennai.pdf is a ward data template, not the HAP. Correct plan link is under HAP_dist_pdfs/Updated_HAP_Chennai.pdf.

sources.title: Telangana Cool Roof Policy 2023–2028
sources.review_note: Primary policy downloaded; selected scanned pages OCR reviewed, including Hyderabad pilot account and policy rationale. No coverage achievement or independent temperature/health outcome claimed; exact mandate/threshold clauses not fully audited.

sources.title: Climate Resilient City Action Plan: Nagpur
sources.review_note: Official-hosted ICLEI-authored plan reviewed selectively. Describes NMC heat activities from 2019; European Commission-funded Urban LEDS II with ICLEI/UN-Habitat. Historical activity report is not a 2026 service inventory.

sources.title: Mumbai building-sector heat-risk implementation pathways: summary
sources.review_note: BMC-hosted report downloaded and reviewed. Combines satellite surface-temperature analysis and weather-station inputs with recommendations; proposed pathways are not completed retrofits or evaluated health benefits.

sources.title: BMC Environment and Climate Change portal
sources.review_note: Official portal links Mumbai Climate Action Plan, building heat-risk summary and climate-budgeting note. Climate action plan not equivalent to a verified stand-alone current HAP.

sources.title: BMC climate budgeting note
sources.publication_date: Date not stated; FY2024–25 report referenced
sources.review_note: One-page official account reviewed. Names C40 pilot and WRI India technical support; describes integration of climate action into budget process, not an additional ring-fenced heat grant.

sources.title: Odisha State Action Plan on Climate Change and Human Health
sources.review_note: Heat chapter, roles and selected front matter reviewed; includes Bhubaneswar in heat-prone list. Health plan does not establish a separate current municipal HAP or completed expenditure.

sources.title: West Bengal State Action Plan on Climate Change and Human Health
sources.review_note: Heat/Kolkata discussion and budget sections reviewed. Historical definitions should not replace current IMD guidance. Climate-health budget is not wholly heat-specific, nor proof of releases.

sources.title: Hess et al.: Ahmedabad HAP mortality analysis
sources.review_note: Original research abstract and authorship reviewed. Ecological pre/post 2007–2010 versus 2014–2015; model-based avoided mortality estimate. Implementing institutions are co-authors; independent programme evaluation not asserted.

sources.title: IIPHG: Deepening and Expanding Heat Health Action in India
sources.review_note: Programme-owner account reviewed: AMC/IIPHG/NRDC collaboration, early warning, clinical capacity, outreach and cool roofs. No current coverage inferred from historical launch.

sources.title: CPR: assessment of Indian heat action plans
sources.review_note: Original document-review description reviewed. Historical sample, not national census of 2026 plans and not an implementation-outcome evaluation.

sources.title: SFC: Is India Ready for a Warming World?
sources.review_note: Original summary/methods reviewed: official interviews across nine cities. Authors explicitly do not verify correct delivery of reported emergency measures. Modelling informs city selection; interviews examine institutions.

sources.title: Hot Take: Cool Roofs — Ahmedabad women workers
sources.review_note: Original study reviewed selectively. Small qualitative/recall study involving 25 women and 2022 income/temperature data. Report title is not proof of an instrumented cool-roof efficacy trial or causal income benefit.

sources.title: NPCCHH district PIP guidance, FY2026–27 and FY2027–28
sources.review_note: Selected budget pathways for health-facility energy assessment, rainwater harvesting and climate-resilient retrofits reviewed. District/state health proposal and sanction route, not an open NGO grant.

sources.title: NCDC Centre for Climate Change and Health resource register
sources.review_note: Programme functions, state-plan links and current PIP/advisory links reviewed. Publication is not universal operational coverage.

sources.title: Common Shade live home page
sources.review_note: Home page reviewed for placement/context only, not independent evidence of Indian programmes. Rendered counters show 18 loops/26 levers; user requested 21-loop/29-lever taxonomy retained in dataset pending schema reconciliation.

sources.title: Tabreed: India district-cooling transaction with Tata Realty
sources.review_note: Original company announcement reviewed. Transaction and proposed acquisition/expansion of existing Gurugram cooling infrastructure; commercial CaaS example, not independent efficiency evaluation or affordable household protection. Marketing-partner site tatarealtyltd.com was not used as an official Tata source.

sources.title: ICICI Lombard ESG report FY2025: Heat Index Cover case study
sources.review_note: Primary insurer report downloaded directly after web-reader size limit; printed page 50 reviewed. Describes SEWA collaboration and heat-income insurance in Gujarat, Rajasthan and Maharashtra. Company-reported underwriting/claims, not independent evaluation. Full policy wording, premium subsidy, basis-risk performance and 2026 access not established.
